scope: Live private Photon room: rendered Editor host and two independent Realtime peers. Verifies transport, sender ownership, shared progress, late join and host handoff. Remote rendered UI and physical Android are not verified.

checks.name: Two independent clients share an invisible private room
Existing network player owns the local exploration controls
All ten adapted topics initialize on the authority
Host starts one shared Truth Table challenge
Guest replica retains independent ownership and cannot consume host input
Forged actor field cannot change the Photon sender's mistake attribution
Wrong answer retains shared work and charges exactly one actor
Attributed mistake uses the existing monster awakening controller
Replayed sequence cannot double-charge a mistake
Late join preserves filled rows and the original mistake actor
Another player completes the same shared answer without erasing the mistake record
Distant guest cannot start or edit a topic
Non-authority snapshot is ignored by host and independent observer
Actual master change preserves trusted team progress and attribution
Two real actors can carry independent copies of a replenishing truth token
Departure returns only the disconnected player's carried item
Mistake identity and saved name survive disconnect
Captured guest cannot work while the uninvolved host stays free
Captured actor's real network edit is rejected
Topic validation leaves the uninvolved player's health intact
Cleanup releases test capture without changing player systems
